text:
Asha (eng-platform): quick sync — yesterday a tenant hit a runaway job and clients got 503s. Console showed `degraded route`. We need a clear contract: when to return 429 vs 503 vs a soft degrade fallback. Opinions?

Luca (eng-runtime): my take: 429 for client/quota exhaustion, 503 for infra capacity (OOM/driver down). 429 should include a subcode and retry hint. 503 can include `X-Redwood-Fallback` header when a cheaper model served.

Maya (product): +1 on semantics but from a UX POV 429 reads like "you're spamming" to customers. We should include a human-friendly body and console banner linking to quota docs. @Sam can we add a short help snippet? :grimacing:

Sam (eng-sre): we'll add metrics and tracing tags. Proposed telemetry names: `tenant.quota.exhausted.count`, `tenant.quota.exhausted.latency_p95`, `route.fallback.count`. Add span attr `redwood.error.kind=quota_exhausted`. Also want a debug header for internal correlation: `X-Redwood-Corr-Id`.

Jules (support): for support flows, include structured body so SDKs can surface nice messages. Example payload we like:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "quota_exhausted",
    "message": "Your project's token budget for this period is exhausted. Visit Console → Quotas to increase or reduce usage.",
    "retry_after_seconds": 1800,
    "help_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/docs/quotas"
  }
}
```

Luca (eng-runtime): header snippet we propose for 429 responses:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining: 0
X-Redwood-Quota-Window-Reset: 1712340000
X-Redwood-Subcode: quota.exhausted
X-Redwood-Route: gen-primary
X-Redwood-Corr-Id: rwd-abc123

Body: { "error": { ... } }
```

Asha (eng-platform): I like that. For 503 we say:

```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Redwood-Subcode: infra.unavailable
X-Redwood-Fallback: gen-small (served)
```

Maya (product): console UX: show a badge on the tenant page "Budget exhausted" with CTA "Request increase" and show last 24h usage sparkline. For routes we show a per-route fail rate and an explanatory tooltip. Also add copy suggestions: short copy for API bodies and longer for console docs.

Sam (eng-sre): rollout plan: add headers and telemetry behind a config flag `x_quota_headers_v1` and enable for 5% canary tenants. Metrics emitted immediately so we can validate. If we see any spike in 4xx churn for SDKs we can roll back.

Asha (eng-platform): approve header names, telemetry keys, and structured error body. @OpsBot can you kick the canary rollout when PR is merged? :thumbsup:

OpsBot (bot): deploy queued — feature/quota-headers -> canary (5%) — started at 6212345705 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/98765

Jules (support): will draft suggested client-facing phrasing for the API error and console banner after canary starts, will share a short runbook for common customer questions.

Asha (eng-platform): thanks. follow-ups: (1) add one-line SDK mapping notes (which SDKs should map 429->QuotaError), (2) quick docs snippet for ops on how to read `X-Redwood-Quota-Window-Reset`. I'll open a tiny RFC with these examples.

Luca (eng-runtime): note: add rate-limiter metric tags: `limit_type=token_budget` and `route=gen-primary` so dashboards can filter.

Sam (eng-sre): will add dashboard panels: "Tenant budget exhaustion" & "Fallbacks by route" and alert on sustained >5/min for a tenant.

Asha (eng-platform): perfect. merging RFC this afternoon. :rocket:
